## 7. Q6 — Racial Wage Gap & Blinder-Oaxaca Decomposition

# Unconditional gap table
race_wages = (
    pums[pums['WAGP'] > 0]
    .groupby('race_eth')
    .apply(lambda g: pd.Series({
        'wtd_mean':   np.average(g['WAGP'], weights=g['PWGTP']),

    }))
    .reset_index()
)
race_wages.to_csv('/content/race_wages.csv', index=False)
print('Saved race_wages.csv')

white_mean = race_wages.loc[race_wages['race_eth'] == 'White NH', 'wtd_mean'].values[0]
race_wages['gap_vs_white'] = race_wages['wtd_mean'] - white_mean
print('Unconditional wage gap by race/ethnicity:')
print(race_wages.to_string(index=False))

# KDE plot — full-time workers only
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 5))
ft = pums[(pums['WAGP'] > 5000) & (pums['full_time'] == 1)]
for race, grp in ft.groupby('race_eth'):
    w = grp['PWGTP'] / grp['PWGTP'].sum()
    sns.kdeplot(x=grp['WAGP'].clip(0, 250_000), label=race, ax=ax, bw_adjust=0.8)
ax.set_xlim(0, 250_000)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mtick.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'${x/1000:.0f}k'))
ax.set_title('Wage Distribution by Race/Ethnicity — Maryland Full-Time Workers (ACS PUMS 2024)')
ax.set_xlabel('Annual Wage')
ax.legend()

plt.show()

# Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition: White NH vs Black NH
white = pums2[(pums2['race_eth'] == 'White NH') & (pums2['log_wage'].notna()) & (pums2['WAGP'] > 0)].copy()
white.to_csv('/content/white_subdataset.csv', index=False)
print('Saved white_subdataset.csv')
black = pums2[(pums2['race_eth'] == 'Black NH')  & (pums2['log_wage'].notna()) & (pums2['WAGP'] > 0)].copy()
black.to_csv('/content/black_subdataset.csv', index=False)
print('Saved black_subdataset.csv')

formula = 'log_wage ~ AGEP + full_time + C(edu_tier) + C(soc2)'
m_w = smf.wls(formula, data=white, weights=white['PWGTP']).fit()
m_b = smf.wls(formula, data=black, weights=black['PWGTP']).fit()

raw_gap = (
    np.average(white['log_wage'], weights=white['PWGTP'])
    - np.average(black['log_wage'],  weights=black['PWGTP'])
)

X_w, X_b = m_w.model.exog, m_b.model.exog
k = min(X_w.shape[1], X_b.shape[1])
X_w, X_b = X_w[:, :k], X_b[:, :k]
b_w = m_w.params[:k]

# Use model.weights (aligned with model.exog) instead of slicing the raw DataFrame;
# statsmodels may drop rows during formula expansion, making positional slicing wrong.
Xbar_w = np.average(X_w, axis=0, weights=m_w.model.weights)
Xbar_b = np.average(X_b, axis=0, weights=m_b.model.weights)

explained   = np.dot((Xbar_w - Xbar_b), b_w)
unexplained = raw_gap - explained

print(f'Raw gap (White − Black):  {raw_gap:.4f}  →  {(np.exp(raw_gap)-1)*100:.1f}%')
print(f'Explained (endowments):   {explained:.4f}  ({explained/raw_gap*100:.1f}% of gap)')
print(f'Unexplained (residual):   {unexplained:.4f}  ({unexplained/raw_gap*100:.1f}% of gap)')

# Decomposition bar chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
bars = ax.barh(
    ['Explained\n(Education, Occupation, Hours)', 'Unexplained\n(Residual / Discrimination)'],
    [explained, unexplained],
    color=['#2196F3', '#F44336']
)
ax.axvline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('Contribution to Log-Wage Gap')
ax.set_title('Blinder-Oaxaca Decomposition: White vs. Black Wage Gap — Maryland')
for bar, val in zip(bars, [explained, unexplained]):
    ax.text(val + 0.003, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
            f'{val:.3f} ({val/raw_gap*100:.0f}%)', va='center')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## 8. Q7 — Nativity & Occupational Sorting

nat_df = pums2[pums2['nativity'].notna() & pums2['WAGP'].notna()]
nat_df.to_csv('/content/nat_df.csv', index=False)
print('Saved nat_df.csv')

nat_occ = nat_df.groupby(['nativity','OCC_TITLE'])['PWGTP'].sum().reset_index()
nat_occ['share'] = nat_occ.groupby('nativity')['PWGTP'].transform(lambda x: x / x.sum())
nat_occ.to_csv('/content/nat_occ.csv', index=False)
print('Saved nat_occ.csv')

fig8 = px.bar(
    nat_occ, x='share', y='OCC_TITLE', color='nativity',
    orientation='h', barmode='group',
    title='Occupation Distribution: Native-born vs. Foreign-born — Maryland',
    labels={'share': 'Share of Workers', 'OCC_TITLE': '', 'nativity': ''}
)
fig8.show()

nat_reg = pums2[pums2['WAGP'] > 0].dropna(
    subset=['log_wage','nativity','edu_tier','AGEP','full_time','soc2']
)
model_nat = smf.wls(
    'log_wage ~ C(nativity, Treatment("Native-born")) + C(edu_tier) + AGEP + full_time + C(soc2)',
    data=nat_reg, weights=nat_reg['PWGTP']
).fit(cov_type='HC3')

nat_coef = model_nat.params.get('C(nativity, Treatment("Native-born"))[T.Foreign-born]', np.nan)
print(f'Foreign-born wage effect (after controls): {nat_coef:.4f}  →  {(np.exp(nat_coef)-1)*100:.1f}%')

# Commute time vs wage quartile

)

)
